_readme: Unit stat tuning. Edit numbers here; the game reloads them on the next build (npm run dev hot-reloads). Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.

base._comment: Stats every Adventurer (and enemy) has at level 1, before weapon bonuses.

growthPerLevel._comment: Added automatically for every level above 1.

_defenseScale: Damage taken is multiplied by defenseScale / (defenseScale + Defense). With 100: 100 Defense = 2x effective HP, 200 = 3x. Negative Defense increases damage taken.
_forestDefense: Extra Defense for a unit standing in forest.
